user.title: EV Charge Planner
user.description: Choose the entities the planner reads. Trips come from calendars (events with a location, routed with Waze Travel Time) or, if no calendar is chosen, from the text helpers described in the README.

data.name: Name
data.location_entity: Car location tracker (optional) – the way home is taken from the SoC while the car is away
data.charge_speed_entity: Charging speed entity (optional), e.g. EV Smart Charging's charging speed in %/h, or a charger power in kW/W – otherwise the Charging power number is used
data.forecast_entity: Price forecast sensor, e.g. Open Spot Forecast (optional)
data.forecast_mae_entities: Forecast error (MAE) sensors for lead day 1, 2, 3, 4 – in that order, e.g. Open Spot Forecast's forecast_mae_day_1…4 (optional)
data.calendar_entities: Calendars with your trips (optional) – events with a location become car trips; km and travel time via Waze Travel Time

init.title: Trips, charging speed and departure

data.notify_targets: Send alerts to – Home Assistant notifications and/or a phone (empty: only the Problem sensor)
data.calendar_entities: Calendars with your trips – empty: use the text helpers
data.home_words: Home words (comma separated) – locations containing one of them are home
data.ignore_words: Ignore words (comma separated) – events with one of them in location, title or description are not driven
data.min_home_minutes: Minimum time at home between two events to drive home
data.charge_speed_entity: Charging speed entity (%/h, kW or W) – leave empty to use the Charging power number
data.forecast_mae_entities: Forecast error (MAE) sensors for lead day 1, 2, 3, 4 – in that order, e.g. Open Spot Forecast's forecast_mae_day_1…4 (empty: forecasts are trusted)
data.default_departure_hour: Departure on days without away hours (hour)

init.description: Calendars: events with a location are car trips (km and travel time from Waze Travel Time). Locations containing a home word, or within 1 km of home, are home; events whose location, title or description contains an ignore word are not driven. Between two events the car goes home when that leaves at least the given time at home. The charging speed entity overrides the Charging power number while it has a usable value. Alerts: missing information is only notified when it lasts (time in brackets); a reminder follows every 24 h and a short message when it is OK again.

options.generic: Generic (list attribute with time and price)

options.plug_in: Plug in the car (charging planned within 2 h, not plugged in)
options.unmet: Not enough time to charge before a departure
options.prices_now: No known price for the current hour (1 h)
options.prices_ahead: No known or forecast prices for the next 3 days (24 h)

max_level_long_trip.name: Max level before a long trip

long_trip_advantage_pct.name: Price advantage for the long-trip cap

forecast_far_factor.name: Forecast error factor beyond the last lead day
